critical_code_review_comments: Minor (carryover from iter257): composeNotes is still duplicated between applyTemplate and submit() in NewMeeting.jsx. Both copies remain identical and short — low priority cleanup.

Nit: TopicPicker.jsx visibleChips memo filters 'all' through (c.key === null) but keeps it always visible regardless of topic count. Fine for current usage; if topics array could ever be empty, chip row would still show 'All 0'. Not a real issue.

Nit: chip-row overflow scrollbar styling could use scrollbar-hide / scrollbar-thin for a cleaner mobile look — currently a thin native scrollbar appears below the chip row on mobile WebKit. Cosmetic only, doesn't affect function.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TopicPicker domain chips are at data-testid='topic-picker-domain-<key>' where key is one of: all, trucking, dewatering, shop, plant, airport, office, general. The chip row container is 'topic-picker-domain-row' (overflow-x-auto). Counts are computed over the FULL topic list and stay stable when filtering. Domain filter and search filter both apply when combined. To load a topic outside the current viewport when picker list overflows, type a few characters in 'topic-picker-search' first then click the item. ES library entries for all 34 new topics include incident_pattern, and applyTemplate's composeNotes prepends 'PATRÓN REAL · lo que suele pasar' in ES vs 'WHAT HAPPENS · real-world pattern' in EN. Legacy 81 untagged topics fall under General chip and have no incident_pattern header.
